title: Not Yet Decided
logline: For months, a household has been going back and forth on whether one of them should go abroad for work. Agency visits, forms half-filled, evenings of the same conversation. Nobody in the house can quite say what they have decided.
human_question: When a decision keeps not getting made, what does the waiting itself do to a family?

premise.story: A household living inside a long, unresolved decision about overseas labour migration: visits to agencies, paperwork started and set aside, conversations that circle without landing, and the practical, financial and emotional weight of staying undecided.
premise.place: A home where this conversation keeps happening, in a region where going abroad for work is a familiar, ordinary path.
premise.experience: The viewer sits inside the family's unfinished sentences and half-filled forms, and feels how heavy simply not deciding can become, without anyone doing anything dramatic at all.

concept_links.why: The sources describe the doubting state of mind as the sparest on their whole list: it cannot reach a decision, and it has no desire to act, only a mind that circles without settling [C028-P:L33; C028-M:L29]. This is offered here only as an analogy for the lived texture of a long, unresolved family decision; the source's doubt is specifically about matters of the teaching, and the film must never claim they are the same thing.

Both sources are explicit that ordinary uncertainty about unknown or undecided matters in life is not the unwholesome doubt they describe, which concerns the teacher and the teaching specifically [C022-P:L179; C022-M:L57]. This film sits entirely in that ordinary kind of uncertainty, and the concept is linked here as a boundary to respect, not a label to apply to the family.

what_camera_could_observe: Visits to a recruitment agency or similar office
Forms started, set aside, picked up again
Evening conversations at home that return to the same open question
The household's daily life continuing underneath the unresolved decision
Whatever the family actually decides, or does not decide, by the end of filming
what_must_be_real: The family's decision, timeline and circumstances must be entirely their own and genuinely unresolved when filming begins; no deadline, meeting or conversation may be arranged for the camera, and the film must not push the family toward any outcome.

possible_arc.opening: A form on a table, half-filled, and the household around it.
possible_arc.turn: A visit, a phone call or a deadline forces the question forward without settling it.
possible_arc.ending_open: Whatever the family has actually decided, or still not decided, by the end of filming ends the film.

position_hint: closing candidate: the group's closing arc is a fog, not knowing which way to go, and a household genuinely unable to settle a real decision is a direct, human form of that fog, handing off into the next group's questions about which way to travel

requirements: A household currently in the middle of a genuine, unresolved decision about overseas labour migration
Willingness from every family member shown to be filmed discussing it
A realistic filming window that can hold an open-ended, possibly unresolved story

suggestions.name: A household in a district with a long-established pattern of overseas labour migration
suggestions.region: Kurunegala or Puttalam district, North Western Province
suggestions.why: A region-level suggestion only; overseas employment for work is a broadly familiar path from many parts of Sri Lanka.
suggestions.verify: A specific family currently facing this decision, and willing to be filmed, must be found and confirmed.

risks: Exploiting real economic hardship for drama
Implying an honest, difficult life decision is any kind of moral failing
The story may not resolve within the filming window, which the film must be able to hold as its own true ending
drop_if: No family in a genuinely unresolved position is willing to be filmed
The family reaches a firm decision before filming can begin, removing the open question at the centre of the film

connections.note: Both are closing candidates: one shows heat that has already cooled, the other a fog that has not yet lifted.
The heaviness of a task some were urged into opens into the deeper stall of a decision no one in a household can quite make.

unknowns: No participant, access or event has been found or confirmed. Everything above is a research direction.
